result.summary: Found 1 minor issue: inconsistent delivery time formatting on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: The delivery time for Tokumaru Ramen Bar displays '25-30 delivery' without the 'min' unit, while other restaurant cards show '15-25 min' and '20-30 min'.
issues.suggestion: Add 'min' to the delivery time text for consistency across all restaurant listings.
